reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on Angelina-themed light and dark visual styling, glass effects, and optional parallax presentation without changing the host conversation layout or controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安洁莉娜亮色与暗色主题、磨砂玻璃样式和可选视差背景效果。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with Angelina-inspired light and dark themes, frosted-glass styling, and optional parallax background effects.

capabilities: Applies light and dark visual themes to DeepSeek Harness
Provides theme selection with browser-local persistence
Modifies visual styling for menus, dialogs, inputs, cards, and message bubbles
